name: Third-party tools and integrations (including SaaS) MUST undergo a Vendor Security Assessment before they can be used to prevent breaches via vulnerable suppliers.
requirementTitle: Third-party tools and integrations (including SaaS) MUST undergo a Vendor Security Assessment before they can be used to prevent breaches via vulnerable suppliers.
requirementDescription: Before a team can use a new supplier, SaaS product, API, integration, or security tool, the supplier's security controls must be assessed and approved.
why: The purpose is to avoid introducing security risks through external vendors.
